backend/main.mo: Motoko actor storing posts with name and comment, providing validation and functions to add and retrieve posts.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two features, their related files, components, tests, and metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing purpose and behavior of various frontend files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining color variables, dark theme overrides, and global element styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/anniversary/content.ts: Central content configuration containing text, milestones, comments, and section settings for the anniversary site.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component assembling all site sections with scroll tracking and conditional video section rendering.
frontend/src/components/AboutNoteSection: Empty placeholder file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/AnniversaryNavba: Responsive navigation bar with scroll-based highlighting and mobile menu using content from centralized config.
frontend/src/components/ClosingBlessingS: Renders the closing blessing section displaying a quote and attribution sourced from the content config.
Comment form with validation and list rendering using posts hooks.
frontend/src/components/DecorativeDivide: Renders a centered decorative image divider using SafeImage.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Displays hero title and intro text using dynamic anniversary content.
Shows anniversary statistics in a grid using computed content fields.
Renders a list of anniversary messages with authors.
frontend/src/components/PatternBackgroun: Applies a fixed repeated background pattern image site-wide.
Displays required content or warns and substitutes when missing.
frontend/src/components/SafeImage.tsx: Loads images safely with error handling and fallback UI.
Renders an alternating timeline of anniversary milestones.
frontend/src/components/VideoMontageSect: Shows an optional video section using local or external video sources.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context, login, and identity loading logic.
frontend/src/hooks/usePosts.ts: Hooks for fetching and adding posts via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base, component, and utility layers plus custom OKLCH theme variables for light/dark modes and adds reusable typography and layout classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it in React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/utils/assetUrl.ts: Builds a static asset URL by combining BASE_URL with a cleaned asset path for correct deployment paths.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom OKLCH color tokens, typography, animations, container settings, and plugins.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s configuration, constraints, removed features, and notes for building a traditional Hindi anniversary website.
